description: This file contains the implementation of the EventParsingIterator class, which decodes, validates, and provides individual events from a binary encoded event stream, as part of the AWS SDK PHP API parser subsystem.

classes.name: EventParsingIterator
classes.description: An iterator that decodes and iterates over events from a binary encoded event stream, handling event headers, payloads, and error conditions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an EventParsingIterator with a stream, shape, and parser, choosing the appropriate decoding iterator based on stream seekability.

methods.name: chooseDecodingIterator
methods.description: Selects and returns a decoding iterator implementation depending on whether the stream is seekable.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current event after parsing, delegating to the decoding iterator.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the key of the current element from the decoding iterator.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the decoding iterator to the next event.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the decoding iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position of the decoding iterator is valid.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Parses a raw event array into a structured form, handling message types and event shapes.

methods.name: parseEventHeaders
methods.description: Extracts header information for an event based on its shape.

methods.name: parseEventPayload
methods.description: Processes the payload of an event, parsing members according to the event shape.

methods.name: parseError
methods.description: Handles error events by throwing an EventStreamDataException with error details.

methods.name: parseInitialResponseEvent
methods.description: Decodes the payload of an initial-response event into an array.
